judge.reason: The diff meets R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT. The new volumeDiscount function takes 5% off each line with 10 or more units, rounding each line down to the cent. price() takes it off before the discount code applies to what remains. The 50% cap now covers the volume and code discounts together, and checkout passes the cart lines to price() so the charge uses the discounted quote. New tests in pricing.test.ts cover per-line rounding (9.5→9 and 10.5→10, sum 19), the code applying after the volume discount (500 + 950 = 1,450, then tax on 8,550 gives a total of 9,830), and the combined cap (5,250 capped to 5,000). A checkout test confirms the customer is charged 9,830. I checked these numbers by hand; I did not run the tests.

finalMessage:
